# Marko Tiosavljević

> AI & LLM scientist, developer and marketer based in Serbia. Researches
> multi-model consensus, self-developing agents, and durable agent memory, and
> builds the production systems that research runs on. Founder of Imba Production LLC.

Role: AI & LLM scientist · developer · marketer. Based in Belgrade / Kragujevac,
Serbia. 38 years in software development, 30 years in marketing, 6 years in AI and
LLM research.

## Research areas

- [Multi-model consensus & reasoning](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#research): how heterogeneous models can be made to agree reliably, and how disagreement can be surfaced rather than averaged away.
- [Autonomous / self-improving agents](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#research): safe self-modification — how much of its own behaviour an agent may rewrite before its guarantees stop holding.
- [Agent memory, guardrails & MCP tooling](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#research): durable memory ranked by stability rather than recency, and guardrails against architectural drift.

## Systems

- [Quorum](https://github.com/magnetoid/Quorum): open-source multi-LLM consensus reasoning engine. Apache-2.0, active.
- [Janus](https://github.com/magnetoid/janus): self-developing, self-healing AI agent. In development.
- [torsor-helper](https://github.com/magnetoid/torsor-helper): local-first MCP server for agent memory and guardrails. MIT.
- [Blob](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#systems): agentic-first AI team workspace. In development.
- [Morpheus OS](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#systems): AI-native commerce operating system. In production.
- [WooPulse](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#systems): AI-powered WooCommerce command center. Live.
- [Tenso](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#systems): experimental language for neural-network development. Exploration.

## Applied work

- [Imba Production LLC](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#applied): founded 2005, Wyoming-registered. Custom omnichannel CRM and marketing applications, and autonomous agents running lead generation and affiliate systems.
- [Cloud Industry LLC](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#applied): co-founded 2014, Delaware.
- [Upwork](https://mtiosavljevic.com/#applied): Top Rated Plus since 2011, 100% Job Success Score, 130+ clients.
